payload.reason: The evidence specifies that the annotators are experts and mentions the involvement of several individuals in the annotation process.

claims.text: The annotators are experts rather than crowdworkers.
Every question in the test set is answered by at least two additional experts to estimate annotation reliability.
The authors acknowledge Eduard Hovy, Lorrie Cranor, Florian Schaub, Joel Reidenberg, Aditya Potukuchi, and Igor Shalyminov for discussions related to the work.
